mapper.update: UPDATE diagram_canvas_state state JOIN diagram diagram ON diagram.id = state.diagram_id AND diagram.user_id = state.user_id SET state.current_xml = #{plan.canvasXml}, state.content_hash = #{plan.contentHash}, state.version = state.version + 1, state.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE state.diagram_id = #{plan.diagramId} AND state.user_id = #{plan.ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 AND state.version = #{plan.expectedVersion} AND (#{plan.expectedContentHash} IS NULL OR #{plan.expectedContentHash} = '' OR state.content_hash = #{plan.expectedContentHash})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram_canvas_state (diagram_id, user_id, current_xml, content_hash, version) SELECT diagram.id, diagram.user_id, #{plan.canvasXml}, #{plan.contentHash}, 1 FROM diagram WHERE diagram.id = #{plan.diagramId} AND diagram.user_id = #{plan.ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagram_canvas_state existing WHERE existing.diagram_id = diagram.id)
mapper.select: SELECT state.diagram_id, state.user_id, diagram.title, diagram.diagram_type, diagram.thumbnail_url, state.current_xml, state.content_hash, state.summary, state.analysis_json, state.version, state.created_at, state.updated_at FROM diagram_canvas_state state JOIN diagram ON diagram.id = state.diagram_id AND diagram.user_id = state.user_id WHERE state.diagram_id = #{plan.diagramId} AND state.user_id = #{plan.ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram_canvas_version (diagram_id, version, content_hash, canvas_xml, mutation_origin, created_by, run_id) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{canvasVersion}, #{plan.contentHash}, #{plan.canvasXml}, #{plan.mutationOrigin}, #{plan.ownerKey}, #{plan.runId})

INSERT INTO source_citation (id, owner_key, target_type, diagram_id, canvas_version, cell_id, claim_key, support_type, state) VALUES (#{citation.citationId}, #{plan.ownerKey}, 'DIAGRAM_CELL', #{plan.diagramId}, #{canvasVersion}, #{citation.cellId}, #{citation.statementKey}, #{citation.supportType}, CASE WHEN #{citation.supportType} = 'EVIDENCE' THEN 'VERIFIED' ELSE NULL END)

INSERT INTO citation_evidence (citation_id, evidence_id, version_id, revision_id, citation_key, use_role, source_origin) VALUES (#{citationId}, #{link.evidenceId}, #{link.versionId}, #{link.revisionId}, #{link.citationKey}, #{link.useRole}, #{link.origin})

INSERT INTO diagram_cell_provenance (diagram_id, cell_id, canvas_version, provenance_ref, semantic_hash, support_type, current_citation_id) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{citation.cellId}, #{canvasVersion}, #{citation.provenanceRef}, #{citation.semanticHash}, #{citation.supportType}, #{citation.citationId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provenance_ref = VALUES(provenance_ref), semantic_hash = VALUES(semantic_hash), support_type = VALUES(support_type), current_citation_id = VALUES(current_citation_id), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO diagram_source_pin (diagram_id, material_id, version_id, processing_revision_id, state, first_used_at, latest_citation_at) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{link.materialId}, #{link.versionId}, #{link.revisionId}, 'ACTIVE', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'ACTIVE', latest_citation_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE diagram_source_pin pin SET pin.state = 'SUPERSEDED', pin.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE pin.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND pin.state = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diagram_cell_provenance provenance JOIN source_citation anchor ON anchor.id = provenance.current_citation_id JOIN source_citation citation ON citation.diagram_id = provenance.diagram_id AND citation.cell_id = provenance.cell_id AND citation.canvas_version = anchor.canvas_version JOIN citation_evidence evidence ON evidence.citation_id = citation.id JOIN evidence_unit unit ON unit.id = evidence.evidence_id JOIN material_version version ON version.id = unit.version_id WHERE provenance.diagram_id = pin.diagram_id AND provenance.canvas_version = #{canvasVersion} AND version.material_id = pin.material_id AND evidence.version_id = pin.version_id AND evidence.revision_id = pin.processing_revision_id )
